treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Poland and the Lebanese Republic for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1999)
eif_quote: Liban | Umowa | 26.07.1999 | 07.11.2003 | 01.01.2004 | 2004 - poz. 2445 (Polish MoF treaty list, via treaty map)
source_title: Dz.U. 2004 Nr 244 poz. 2445: Convention Poland-Lebanon (Polish/English text, scanned), published by podatki.gov.pl

rates.quote: 2. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the effective (beneficial) owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the effective (beneficial) owner of the interest, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the effective (beneficial) owner of the royalties, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (Lebanon not an MLI signatory; only an article-level anti-abuse clause in Art. 11(8))

notes: Art. 29: EIF on the 30th day after the last notification; WHT applies to amounts of income derived on or after 1 January of the calendar year following EIF (2003-11-07) -> 2004-01-01 (Polish list: applicable 01.01.2004). Single 5% rate for all three categories. Art. 11(3): interest derived by the other State's Government, local authorities, agencies/bank units, or on debt-claims guaranteed/insured/financed by a wholly government-owned financial institution, exempt (not modelled). Art. 11(8): interest article does not apply where the main purpose of creating/assigning the debt-claim was to take advantage of it. Royalties include equipment and satellite/cable transmission. English text prevails.
